concepts.name: gradient descent
concepts.explanation: An iterative optimisation algorithm that moves parameters opposite to the gradient of a loss function.

concepts.name: learning rate
concepts.explanation: A hyperparameter that scales each update step in gradient-based training.

concepts.name: momentum
concepts.explanation: A method that accumulates an exponentially decaying average of past gradients to smooth updates.

concepts.name: adam
concepts.explanation: An optimiser that combines momentum with per-parameter adaptive learning rates.
